en.title: Multiset Jaccard Similarity
en.description:
Compute the Jaccard similarity of character multisets. The source's example shows that repeated characters count and gives 0.4; this site adds non-empty strings and the standard input protocol.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: Two lines with non-empty strings containing only lowercase English letters, each of length 1..10^5.
en.output: Output the multiset Jaccard similarity: Σmin(countA[c],countB[c]) / Σmax(countA[c],countB[c]), with an error of at most 1e−6.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: This is a multiset, not a set of deduplicated characters.
